summary: Household names with good surprises: Bruno Mars on top, Coldplay in, Ed Sheeran and Billie Eilish out. Daily quality, but it already ran on 2026-10-26.
reasons: Casual found 8 and spent all 5 lives on Ed Sheeran #17, Billie Eilish #15, Dua Lipa #19, Beyonce #33 and Eminem #20: all near misses you learn from.
Fan went 10/10 losing 2; Lady Gaga and Coldplay are the forgotten ones. Blitz is deep: 27 of 30 casual names scored.
Low priority only because it ran as daily #7 four days ago; the scheduler won't reuse it, so it now serves random play and Random Blitz.
